name: Velodyne Puck (VLP-16)
mpn: VLP-16 (Puck); Puck LITE and Puck Hi-Res share the housing
description: 16-channel 360° spinning lidar with a 30° vertical FOV, 100 m range and Ethernet UDP output via an interface box.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: 100 m; accuracy up to ±3 cm typical

specs.label: Scan / sample rate
specs.value: 5–20 Hz rotation, 0.1°–0.4° azimuth resolution; ~300,000 pts/s single return, ~600,000 dual

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: 903 nm (spec table; overview text says 905 nm), Class 1 eye-safe (IEC 60825-1:2007 & 2014)

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: 100 Mbps Ethernet, UDP packets; GPS/PPS sync via interface box

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 8 W typical; 9–18 V (with interface box and regulated supply)

specs.label: Weight / protection
specs.value: ~830 g without cabling and interface box; IP67

envelope.axes: x/y = body diameter Ø103.3, z = height from bottom face; cable gland adds up to 12.7 mm radially

features.label: Bottom mounting
features.value: 1/4-20 threaded mount at the centre, 9/32 in (7.1 mm) deep; 2× Ø0.16 in (≈4.06 mm) holes for 5/32 in locating pins, 7/32 in (5.5 mm) deep, 88.9 mm (3.50 in) apart on a diameter through the centre (on the 90° axis, perpendicular to the 0° cable-exit axis).
features.source: 63-9229 Rev K Puck datasheet p.1 'Dimensions' (bottom view)

features.label: Optical centre
features.value: 37.8 mm (1.49 in) above the bottom face; active window 38.1 mm (1.50 in) tall, full 360°; lower housing band 18.8 mm (0.74 in).
features.source: 63-9229 Rev K Puck datasheet p.1 (side view)

features.label: Cable
features.value: Side cable exit at 0°, gland/cable protrudes up to 12.7 mm (0.50 in) from the body; optional M12 connector (Phoenix Contact SACC-M12FS-8CON-PG 9-SH, Ø20, ~56 long).

notes: Ouster's current VLP-16 page markets 200 m range, 40° vertical FOV and 16–32 channels — that describes newer Puck variants; the Rev K datasheet (100 m, 30°, 16 ch) is used here. Wavelength conflict inside the datasheet: 903 nm in the spec table vs 905 nm in the overview. No Amazon listing for the sensor itself (only power adapters); search URL given.
